pokemon-cards-css by Simon Goellner (@simeydotme)

Commit acb1197633e749a1fba4412231db2f6581586d00

The CSS files in this directory are verbatim upstream copies under GPL-3.0.
See LICENSE. UPSTREAM.json records SHA-256 hashes for byte-for-byte checks.
SpiralDex cards.css adapts the upstream image-face layout to accessible HTML,
sets clipping to our artwork panel, and supplies a CSS foil pattern. No upstream
card illustrations or external texture files are bundled or requested.
card-renderer.js drives upstream pointer, rotation, and background variables.
